name: Scars of a Ghost
source:
Kings is a former black-operations soldier whose official identity was erased after a staged death. Years before the war, he was a lost child in a Los Angeles orphanage, where he met Savannah Stevens, the girl who called him Bunny and taught him that firecrackers do not cry.

Years later, Kings has survived into scars, false records, and a private security company. Savannah has survived into silence, underworld power, and a city that learned to fear her. Each believes the other was lost.

Scars of a Ghost follows their history from childhood through separation, military transformation, criminal power, and the collision of two lives shaped by the same wound.
